method: Re-derived every expected answer by hand and with Python (sums, products, threshold comparisons, prefix counts, search ranking and 160-char snippet offsets replayed through lab/core.py). Read checker semantics in lab/core.py. Compared all 42 tasks against dev.json and gen_1..gen_3 for duplicates. Probed changed checkers with alternative correct surface forms and wrong answers. Model was not run on these tasks.

residual_notes: g4-08 and g4-14 share the 'get key, act only above/below a threshold' skeleton with dev-10, but differ in action type (file delete vs message) and use numeric conditions; kept.
g5-13 (key names a file) mirrors gen_1 g1-18 (file names a key); kept as a different direction and sub-theme.
